capabilities: Draw a colour-coded minimap of the current note
Provide a draggable scrollbar with page bubble
Jump to next or previous heading with arrow buttons
Bookmark pages across notes and tabs
Zoom note text with pinch gestures
extras: Full Screen Guard is experimental and off by default; update checks contact GitHub only when enabled.
problem: Long notes are hard to navigate and Obsidian's native scrollbar gives little sense of position or structure.

relations.evidence: It was a separate plugin and is now built in.
It was a separate plugin (Tab Arrows 2.0.0) and is now built in.

summary: Minimap and scrollbar plugin that adds a colour-coded overview beside each note for drag-and-tap navigation and page tracking.
